acp_protocol.changelog_note: ACP bridge scopes, capabilities, commands, permission outcomes, and binding vocabularies are pinned; run.get is read-only run status.

enums.changelog_note: ACP transport labels identify the bridge ingress.
enums.name: AcpTransportKind

enums.changelog_note: ACP scopes are authorization inputs and must remain explicit.
enums.name: AcpScope

enums.changelog_note: ACP capabilities are negotiated bridge features.
enums.name: AcpCapability

enums.changelog_note: ACP command names are public method identifiers; run.get exposes read-only run status and acp.status remains an alias.
enums.name: AcpCommand

enums.changelog_note: ACP session modes are policy-visible execution states.
enums.name: AcpSessionMode

enums.changelog_note: Permission bridge outcomes mirror approval results.
enums.name: AcpPermissionDecision

enums.changelog_note: ACP ledger event kinds are retained for reconnect replay.
enums.name: AcpEventLedgerKind

enums.changelog_note: Conversation binding sensitivity drives connector-independent filtering.
enums.name: ConversationBindingSensitivity

enums.changelog_note: Conversation binding conflict states are explain and repair inputs.
enums.name: ConversationBindingConflictState

enums.changelog_note: ACP binding conflict kinds keep expired_reference as a deprecated alias.
enums.name: AcpBindingConflictKind

enums.changelog_note: ACP repair action names are audited apply inputs.
enums.name: AcpBindingRepairActionKind

attempt_classifications.changelog_note: Harness attempt classifications avoid generic provider/runtime error strings in diagnostics and replay.
attempt_classifications.name: AgentHarnessAttemptClassification

attempt_replay_safety.changelog_note: Harness attempt replay-safety labels distinguish deterministic replay from side-effect-uncertain attempts.
attempt_replay_safety.name: AgentHarnessAttemptReplaySafety

attempt_terminal_statuses.changelog_note: Harness attempt terminal statuses are stable across embedded, plugin, and future native runtimes.
attempt_terminal_statuses.name: AgentHarnessAttemptTerminalStatus

callback_kinds.changelog_note: Harness callbacks are the only supported path for reply, model, tool, approval, verification, lifecycle, and final outcome events.
callback_kinds.name: AgentHarnessCallbackKind

agent_harness.changelog_note: Agent harness contracts keep provider resolution, auth, transcript, workspace, sandbox, tool policy, callbacks, journal writes, and structured attempt results host-owned.

selection_modes.changelog_note: Harness selection modes are policy-visible and must not silently fall back for mutating attempts.
selection_modes.name: AgentHarnessSelectionMode

support_outcomes.changelog_note: Harness support outcomes are audited before an attempt is routed.
support_outcomes.name: AgentHarnessSupportOutcome

terminal_classifications.changelog_note: Terminal classifications provide one shared wait, journal, and diagnostics vocabulary across harness owners.
terminal_classifications.name: AgentHarnessTerminalClassification

capability_grants.changelog_note: Hook capability grants are host-issued and plugins cannot self-escalate to raw or mutating data.
capability_grants.name: AgentHookCapabilityGrant

agent_hooks.changelog_note: Agent hooks define stable hook names, default redaction, capability grants, timeouts, priorities, and decision shapes.

decision_authority.changelog_note: Hook authority distinguishes observe-only hooks from hooks that may affect control flow.
decision_authority.name: AgentHookDecisionAuthority

decision_kinds.changelog_note: Agent hook decision names cover run gates, delivery rewrites, and tool-result middleware outcomes.
decision_kinds.name: AgentHookDecisionKind

kinds.changelog_note: Agent hook names are public plugin and harness extension points.
kinds.name: AgentHookKind

redaction_postures.changelog_note: Hook redaction postures describe the strongest payload view available without additional trusted grants.
redaction_postures.name: AgentHookRedactionPosture

changelog_note: Adds agent hook, harness, and tool-result middleware contracts to the public runtime snapshot.

compatibility_policy.changelog_note: Breaking public contract changes require a snapshot version bump plus migration note in the same change.

hook_enums.changelog_note: Hook phases accept short names and legacy run:* event names.
hook_enums.name: RunLifecycleHookPhase

hook_enums.changelog_note: Hook decision names are arbitration inputs and may not be renamed without a migration.
hook_enums.name: RunLifecycleHookDecisionKind

public_error_envelopes.changelog_note: Canonical public API, CLI, and stream error envelope with stable category and reason code.
public_error_envelopes.name: PalyraErrorEnvelope

public_error_envelopes.changelog_note: Stable errors expose code, message, and recovery_hint only.
public_error_envelopes.name: StableErrorEnvelope

public_error_envelopes.changelog_note: Realtime compatibility errors may include supported protocol version range.
public_error_envelopes.name: RealtimeErrorEnvelope

public_error_envelopes.changelog_note: ACP compatibility errors may include supported protocol version range.
public_error_envelopes.name: AcpErrorEnvelope

public_runtime_events.changelog_note: Public stream vocabulary is shared by Responses-compatible streaming, runs events, QA Lab, trajectory export, ACP, and observability.

realtime_protocol.changelog_note: Realtime handshake, command, event, and error vocabularies are pinned for console and agent clients.

enums.changelog_note: Realtime roles are negotiated during handshake.
enums.name: RealtimeRole

enums.changelog_note: Realtime scopes are authorization inputs and must remain explicit.
enums.name: RealtimeScope

enums.changelog_note: Realtime capabilities are feature negotiation outputs.
enums.name: RealtimeCapability

enums.changelog_note: Realtime command names are public method identifiers.
enums.name: RealtimeCommand

enums.changelog_note: Realtime event topics drive subscription filtering.
enums.name: RealtimeEventTopic

enums.changelog_note: Realtime event sensitivity labels are applied before serialization.
enums.name: RealtimeEventSensitivity

runtime_enums.changelog_note: Run states keep legacy persisted labels as deprecated aliases.
runtime_enums.name: RunLifecyclePhase

runtime_enums.changelog_note: Audit actor names are stable and user remains an alias for principal.
runtime_enums.name: RuntimeActorKind

runtime_enums.changelog_note: Idempotency state labels preserve in_progress and succeeded aliases.
runtime_enums.name: IdempotencyOperationState

runtime_enums.changelog_note: Replay decision names are canonical public reason codes.
runtime_enums.name: IdempotencyReplayDecision

tool_result_projection.changelog_note: Tool result projection wire names pin visibility, policy, decision, sensitivity, and retention output.

enums.changelog_note: Visibility values define what reaches the model, audit artifact, or redacted preview.
enums.name: ToolResultVisibility

enums.changelog_note: Projection policy names are policy-visible and persisted in audit records.
enums.name: ToolResultProjectionPolicyKind

enums.changelog_note: Projection decisions are audit-visible and must remain stable.
enums.name: ToolResultProjectionDecisionKind

enums.changelog_note: Sensitivity labels drive artifact read gates and must not be broadened silently.
enums.name: ToolResultSensitivity

enums.changelog_note: Retention dispositions are durable artifact lifecycle vocabulary.
enums.name: ArtifactRetentionDisposition

middleware.changelog_note: Runtime-neutral tool-result middleware may only preserve or downgrade model visibility while keeping audit artifacts host-owned.
